notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l003: Semetey calls Kanykei elder sister and Manas brother-in-law because he does not yet know his parentage; narrator explicitly confirms283:3:26–27. Do not silently correct these to mother/father. His wish she were mother is dramatic irony, not genealogical evidence against actual parentage.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l004: Primary Yudakhin баглан quotes exact баглан козу ширин баш бор кайнатып коюптур: weaned lamb and tasty head boiled vigorously/thoroughly. Corrected initial plump to weaned; бор not wine/chalk. Head and lamb both retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l006: Primary жая I rump meat, commonly horse; жал neck fat food here, not mane hair. No extra slaughter scene.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l008: Seventy different foods explicit, no deduplication of spread descriptions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l012: Санаасы менен boltur arranging by thought/planning, not magical conjuring claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l017: Forty years of hardship conditional and wealth could buy Bukhara literal epic scale, not independently financial fact.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l023: Visually indented Shaatemir24 joined into one verse with Temir Khan. Koloykan/Ismail separate25. Four named owners retained; no fifth king invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l028: Their combined wealth not even one portion of sister’s, no unsupported percentage.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l033: Ravine/spring wish metaphor maintained before orphan-child wish35–37; no literal bodily transformation narrated.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l037: Чунак only/hard-won child, not earless physical injury.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b003:l039: Primary Yudakhin желе I foal-tether line stretched between stakes. Kara-Kyr stretched ridge imagined as own tether line; no invented horse herd count.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l005: Camel-calf endearment for human child retained, not actual camel birth.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l010: White-loins/birth imagery literal lineage wish, no added sexual detail.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l012: Kicking out of mother’s womb literal birth image, not actual current attack.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l014: Primary Yudakhin бурак II mythic mount, also figurative swift steed; six-month mount wish here rendered swift steed instead of asserting the Prophet’s named Buraq. Animal/support metaphor then lamp-child wish16–17 both retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l015: Энем mother briefly used in wish even while other lines эжем sister; source fluctuation not harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l023: Кешиги жок unlucky, no food leftovers or failure to share charity invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l033: Childless in source quotation marks retained; speaker unaware of own identity, not author assertion she had no child.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0282:b004:l034: Каңырык grief idiom, smoldering heart image not literal bodily smoke. Hunting departure returns283, no missing elapsed trip filled in.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l001: Ителги saker falcon primary species; clear eyes without blinking filled tears. No ophthalmic diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l006: Кечээ temporal recollection rendered once, not exact previous calendar day inconsistent with twelve-year upbringing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l010: Primary Yudakhin була IV exact буласын булап = plunder valuables, confirmed independently worker222–241 for223/234. Literal plundering riches and prospering retained despite incongruous recovery context. Agent/referent of possessive unstated; no invented victim or raid. Restored initial withheld verse after lexical evidence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l012: Шай protective patron, not tea. Twelve limbs/body parts conventional whole-body formulation, not literal extra human limbs.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l014: Warrior matching departed Manas, not Manas’s reincarnation asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l017: Joining people/society somehow, modest qualifier эптеп retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l022: Severed joined/scattered gathered parallel images both retained, no compressed recovery summary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l025: Printed белек primary gift, rendered gift coat that arrows cannot pierce; potential бөлөк other/foreign arrow spelling not silently emended. Specialist reading desirable for modifier attachment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l028: Twelve years study retained, no assumption modern school curriculum; дарс lessons rather than specific institution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l033: Казы horse belly fat in food list, not Islamic judge; honey separate, sugar snow comparison34 separate.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b003:l038: Primary Yudakhin кулкулдабат=(кул ху аллаху ахад), opening Quran112. Directly translated opening Say: He is God, the One, not unrelated title or merging Tabbat. Next line devout recitation/dedication retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l002: Таппат primary entry Quran chapter opening, rendered conventional Tabbat name; dictionary calls it third in study context, no inaccurate absolute chapter number asserted. Distinct from preceding112.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l004: Kanykei weeps while dedication to Manas spirit described; exact reciter/dedication subject shifts qualified, no new prayer author invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l007: Open palms blessing action retained, not clasped hands.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l011: Mother addresses own son little brother to conceal relationship, source explicit.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l015: Primary бейпай suffering/distress, not giant or tax demand. Wealth smashed/shared by fools next verses retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l018: Looming dark head and torn bloody face literal grief/assault account, no extra wound description.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l024: Widowhood exposed as vulnerability inferred by attack sequence, explicit widow term retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l026: Twelve doors/gates all flung open, no invented twelve city districts.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l029: Буламды булап robbing wealth exact primary, no unexplained silk-count substitution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l032: Venerable mother is Chyiyrdy, mother-in-law addressed mother by Kanykei; brought from Talas on shoulders, no wheeled transport invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l035: River grandeur metaphor for mother, not geographical river named Aiding.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0283:b005:l037: Ninety-five explicit age preserved, not ninety or exact independently established historical age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l002: Primary Yudakhin меке III maternal affectionate sacred object of devotion, not literal trip to Mecca or city blood from horse injury. Sacred refuge rendered consistently2/10/20/28.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l004: Урмеке=sacred mother exact primary Seytek1991 glossaryPDF352, independently image-inspected earlier. No proper name Urmeke or Mecca substitution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l005: Primary баанай=маана protection/refuge, exact башымдагы баанайым; shelter above head, not forehead ornament.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l006: Бадышалуу Kyrgyz with sovereign, direct non-metathesized adjective, consistent restored106/125 royal-city readings.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l011: Spear pennon/mother gift/sailing ship successive metaphors retained, no actual sailboat transporting mother invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l012: Argyn and Kyrgyz two tribes named, no modern ethnic classification imposed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l017: Forehead/brow strengthens on seeing literal affectionate bodily image, exact syntax qualified, not invisible healing cure.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l021: Primary баргек forehead ornament; figurative object of love/hope, exact dictionary examples. Courser hero metaphor leaves cherished jewel (mother), not actual horse ornament donated in new event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l022: Primary тумшугу жок катын unhappy woman or barren woman. Luckless chosen, not literal beaklessness or certain infertility.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l024: Mirror above head literal alongside banner, no invented protective device.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l025: Seeing her makes belly full source figurative comfort, not literal meal given here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l029: One lionlike son and one warrior daughter, Manas and Kardygach, not daughter’s own son. Paired offspring maintained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l035: Kakan named territory retained, no automatic Beijing/Kokand substitution. Equal stars36 metaphor matched prowess, not astronomical observation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l003: Seventy days spear fighting explicit. House-sized giants die, runners too heavy for horses literal epic scale.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l008: Kardygach daughter of Zhakyp; Saikal daughter of Karacha. Both warrior women, no merged person or gender change.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l011: Chubak and Kyrgylchal associated with letter, recipients later opponents; narrator variant retained, no replacement with other companions to match prior volume.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l013: Offended on being blamed/slandered literal provisional agent unspecified; no new stated motive of individual revenge.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l019: Кечил monk/Kalmyk context; monks’ khan, warrior swine source hostile epithet, not project religious judgment. Cotton belt/broad boots separately retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l020: 6000 Chinese, countless kalday governors, names Zholoi/Ylama/Ezkara all retained. Түмөн myriads in force description not exact additional ten-thousand invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l025: Forty companions flee and Manas left alone as letter’s report; not independently verified event or edited to defend heroes’ reputation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l031: Ак жазайыл white falconets here military flags/attack context, primary firearm sense unlike220 metaphor misfortune. Two banner/weapon descriptions not merged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b004:l039: Remaining alive, no unsupported barely added; sentence continues285.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0284:b003:l019: Kanykey identifies Chyyyrdy as her only support after loss, with no kin or people remaining to sustain her. Bereaved widow context; preserve self-abasing shade in note. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation.
